jsesh.graphicExport
Class IPDFExporter

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.graphicExport.IPDFExporter
public class IPDFExporter
extends java.lang.Object

Expert for exporting a Manuel de codage file to PDF, using the IText library. We use the very complete and mature IText library (which we will also use for RTF output. dwAw Hr aW.y pA nTr).

This class was written quite fast, from a cut and paste of HTMLExporter. It should be cleaned a lot.

rosmord
